name: V-Poker Frontends
postCreateCommand: for d in client admin-dashboard support-dashboard agent-dashboard; do (cd $d && npm install --legacy-peer-deps); done
postStartCommand: ROOT=/workspaces/v-poker-yefeng; pkill -f vite 2>/dev/null; nohup sh -c "cd $ROOT/client && npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173" > /tmp/vite-client.log 2>&1 & nohup sh -c "cd $ROOT/admin-dashboard && npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5174" > /tmp/vite-admin.log 2>&1 & nohup sh -c "cd $ROOT/agent-dashboard && npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5175" > /tmp/vite-agent.log 2>&1 & nohup sh -c "cd $ROOT/support-dashboard && npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5176" > /tmp/vite-support.log 2>&1 &
